data_product_description: See prescribing of Minocycline Hydrochloride, measured as Average Daily Quantities (ADQs) per 1,000 registered patients.
data_product_overview:
## Access information
To gain access to 'Catalyst', you will be required to input an ID and password:
ID - NHSBSAGuest
Password - Password12345
If the password is locked for any reason the system automatically reinstates the password. This may take up to 20 minutes.

Note that your browser may give you warning that this is part of a data breach. As this is a publicly available user name and password you do not need to take any action and can login using the provided generic user ID and password.

## About this dashboard
This report shows Minocycline Hydrochloride prescribing. It presents results by quarter, and compares them with the same quarter last year.

The measure is the number of Average Daily Quantities (ADQs) of minocycline per 1,000 registered patients. You can use this to compare prescribing activity across organisations of different sizes.
